title: AI notice
intro: The answers on wahl.chat are generated by artificial intelligence. They are based on information extracted from publicly available party and election manifestos. While wahl.chat strives to provide accurate information about the parties' positions and values, please note:
automated: All content is processed and generated automatically.
notOfficial: The answers are not official party statements.
nuance: Complex political positions may not be captured in every nuance.
storage: Your messages are stored so that we can generate the answers and show you your chat history. Find out more in our privacy policy.
outro: This AI chat is meant as an educational tool for getting to know different political positions. For binding information, please refer to the official party sources.
